purpose: Resolve the independent correctness, integration, evidence, and manuscript review without replacing historical outcomes.
changes: typed unambiguous request representation and structural envelope
Unicode capacity and trusted admission clock
durable reservation on the actual proxy path
full pin/test/variant/oracle bundles and offline verification
per-field adaptive request changes and separate completion outcomes
related work, worked example, manuscript and dated packaging
selection_rule: Reuse all twelve previously selected registry servers in their original order; first six development, next six held-out. Do not replace inference failures.
named_servers: previously built official GitHub MCP image, resolved to its immutable image ID

workload.additional_adaptive_suite: Change and append to every applicable JSON string leaf, including nested leaves. Save each original and changed request sequence.

durable_suite: concurrent proxy requests for final call allowance

poisoning_suite.interpretation: Agreement tests stability, not honesty. Report the stable poisoner even if it defeats comparison.

metrics: fixed-suite and adaptive per-field cases separately
success_rule: All confirmed regression examples must be refused, durable restart/race tests must prevent second sends, and saved network bundles must reproduce their own decisions offline. Scientific security/utility results are reported regardless of thresholds; prior failed gates remain failed.
artifact_rule: Every scored run gets a new directory. Preserve old results, exact source hashes, immutable image IDs, plans, and all failed runs. Commit this plan before scoring.
scope: Existing cached images and tools first. Expanded held-out packages require separately documented selection and the download authorization required by CLAUDE.md. No paid LLM or live user API action is necessary for these repairs.
